brand.tagline: The world’s reference for flying with your dog.
cta.sub: Any airline, country and breed — an instant, sourced answer.
cta.default: Check if your dog can fly on this route
verdict.conditional: Your dog can fly — with conditions
report.alternatives_hint: No placement works as requested. Try a lower cabin-weight airline, shift the date out of the heat window, or split the journey — the engine will list feasible options.
air.to_confirm: Policy to confirm with the airline
air.not_accepted: Not compatible with this dog or this route
air.fee_cargo_quote: Cargo — quoted by the freight agent
air.unverified_note: Potentially relevant airline — it serves both airports, but no published segment establishes a continuous itinerary. Itinerary and acceptance of your dog to be confirmed with the airline.
air.heat_embargo: Hold & cargo suspended for your travel date — seasonal heat embargo
report.safety_note: Advice, not a refusal: it does not change the statuses shown below. The official wording is quoted under each advisory.
report.climate_est: About {temp}°C expected at your destination around your travel date.
report.climate_embargo: At this temperature, some airlines suspend hold and cargo for animal welfare (seasonal heat embargo). Affected airlines are still listed below and clearly marked.
report.climate_to_confirm: Estimated heat above the carriers' threshold: hold/cargo policies are to be confirmed with each airline for this date.
report.climate_heat_signal: High estimated heat (a modelled estimate, not a forecast). No listed airline has a channel to confirm for this date — see each card.
report.climate_ok: Below the {threshold}°C heat-embargo threshold — no seasonal hold/cargo restriction on this date.
report.climate_risk: With climate change, heat waves above 30°C are increasingly possible at your destination in this season. On very hot days, some airlines suspend hold and cargo — possible, but not confirmed for your date.
partner.insurance.reason: This route needs vet paperwork — pet travel insurance covers the unexpected.
partner.equipment.reason: Hold travel requires a crate suited to your dog and accepted by the airline operating the flight.
partner.equipment.reason_cargo: Cargo is booked with a freight agent, not at check-in: quote, drop-off and pick-up at the cargo terminal, and a crate suited to your dog, accepted by the agent and by the airline operating the flight.
partner.vet.reason: Find a vet for the health certificate and required tests.
finder.brachy_note: Snub-nosed breed — extra hold & heat restrictions
finder.date_hint: Optional — used to estimate seasonal heat at the destination (hold/cargo heat embargoes).
finder.eu_passport: Does your dog usually live in the European Union?
finder.eu_passport_no: No, it's new to the EU
finder.eu_passport_hint: A dog that lives in the EU comes home on its EU pet passport, as long as its rabies vaccination has stayed valid. A dog that is new to the EU goes through the health certificate instead.
finder.fill_hint: Choose a destination and enter your dog's weight to see the comparison.
finder.error_body: No result could be produced for your search. Please try again in a moment — we never show a sample answer in place of yours.
finder.origin_invalid: Pick a departure city or airport from the suggestions.
finder.dest_invalid: Pick a destination city or airport from the suggestions.
finder.same_endpoint: Departure and destination must be different.
finder.weight_invalid: Enter a weight greater than 0 kg.
finder.weight_too_high: That weight looks too high — please check it (max 100 kg).
finder.no_match_mode: No airline matches this mode on this route — see the alternatives below.

home.example.body: Golden Retriever · 11 kg · 34 °C · Paris → Tokyo → a verdict with conditions, warnings, risks, alternatives and sources. Run the Finder above to see it.
home.trust.title: Every rule is sourced and dated — or flagged as unconfirmed
home.trust.body: For information we have re-verified, we give the source, the verification date, the next review and the confidence level. A policy that has not been re-verified is flagged « to confirm », and no source is presented as proof. Target review cycle: 90 days for airlines, 180 days for countries.

answer.question: Can my dog fly?
section.compatibility_note: All airlines on this route, combined — not a single carrier's score
why.no_cabin: No airline on this route takes your dog in the cabin — {modes} only
why.no_cabin_brachy: Cabin travel isn't possible on this route, and hold/cargo are ruled out for your snub-nosed breed (breathing risk)
why.no_airline_found: No airline in our data covers this exact route, direct or via a plausible connection — this may be a gap in our coverage, not proof the route doesn't exist
why.no_docs: No special import paperwork on this route
premium.unreviewed: We have not yet reverified this condition against a current official source — confirm it directly with the airline.
premium.policy_unpublished: The airline does not publish conditions for this channel — ask it before booking.
premium.airline_approval: Accepted case by case: the airline must give its approval.
codeshare.notice: On a codeshare flight, the airline selling the ticket may be different from the airline operating the flight. Your dog’s travel conditions may therefore depend on the operating carrier. Always check the “operated by” notice before booking.
